sources.quote: HD 30856 is a binary system between HD 30856 A, a K-type giant star, and HD 30856 B, a red dwarf companion, located in the constellation of Eridanus about 430 light-years distant.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 4.8 solar radii and 1.66 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,014 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
